home_hero_headline: Elite Travel Baseball. Built on Fundamentals.
home_hero_subheadline: Competitive teams, professional coaching, and a first-class facility for players who want to take their game to the next level.
home_intro: Eagles Baseball Travel is a youth travel baseball organization offering competitive teams, skills camps, and year-round training for players ages 9U–17U.
home_mission_body: Our mission is to develop athletes physically, mentally, socially, and interpersonally. We prioritize each player's growth as an individual, a teammate, and a baseball player over wins, records, and accolades. Wins follow when the development is right.
home_belief: We are developing more than baseball players — we are developing young men who know how to lead, work hard, serve others, overcome challenges, and succeed both on and off the field.
home_philosophy_body: Our coaches challenge every athlete on and off the field while creating a positive, fun, learning-focused environment. We hold high standards, teach leadership and teamwork, and expect discipline and character from every player who wears the Eagles uniform.

home_values.title: Discipline
home_values.description: Show up prepared, on time, and ready to work — every practice, every game.

home_values.title: Leadership
home_values.description: Set the example for teammates through effort, attitude, and how you treat others.

home_values.title: Selflessness
home_values.description: Put the team first. Celebrate a teammate's success like it is your own.

home_values.title: Work Ethic
home_values.description: Development is earned through repetition and effort, not talent alone.

home_values.title: Confidence
home_values.description: Trust your preparation and compete without fear of failure.

home_values.title: Teamwork
home_values.description: Nine players moving together will always beat nine individuals.

home_values.title: Character
home_values.description: Do the right thing when no one is watching, on and off the field.

home_values.title: Accountability
home_values.description: Own your mistakes, learn from them, and hold each other to the standard.

home_goals_body: Every Eagles team works toward the same four goals each season.

home_goals.title: Building Relationships
home_goals.description: Coaches, players, and families who know, trust, and support one another — relationships that last well beyond a single season.

home_goals.title: Player & Baseball Skill Development
home_goals.description: Measurable improvement in every player's fundamentals, athleticism, and baseball IQ from the first practice to the last game.

home_goals.title: Team Cohesion & Sportsmanship
home_goals.description: Teams that play for each other, respect opponents and umpires, and represent the Eagles with class win or lose.

home_goals.title: Positive Camaraderie
home_goals.description: A dugout and a program that players love being part of — fun, encouraging, and focused on growth.

home_development_body: Eagles Baseball runs on a professional coaching model. Every team, at every age level, is led by experienced coaches who follow a consistent development plan — we do not concentrate our best instruction on the top teams. A 10U player receives the same quality of coaching and the same commitment to development as a 14U player preparing for high school ball.

home_development_tiers.title: 10U – 11U
home_development_tiers.description: Fundamentals first: throwing, fielding, hitting, and baserunning mechanics, baseball IQ, and the habits of work ethic, character, focus, and hard work.

home_development_tiers.title: 12U – 14U
home_development_tiers.description: Increased competition, advanced baseball development, and elite athletic training that prepares players for the high school level.

home_development_tiers.title: High School
home_development_tiers.description: A continued development path for Eagles players at the high school level — strength, skill, and the competitive reps needed to keep advancing.

home_year_round_body: The Eagles are not a spring-and-summer organization. Development continues through the winter with structured indoor training so players return to the field ahead of where they left it.

home_year_round_items.title: Hitting & Pitching Instruction
home_year_round_items.description: Small-group cage and mound work with Eagles coaches all winter long.

home_year_round_items.title: Position-Specific Defense
home_year_round_items.description: Infield, outfield, and catching sessions focused on footwork, reads, and reps.

home_year_round_items.title: Strength, Speed & Agility
home_year_round_items.description: Age-appropriate athletic training that builds strength, quickness, and durability.

home_year_round_items.title: Baseball IQ
home_year_round_items.description: Situational baseball, game strategy, and the mental side of competing.

home_whats_new_body: Big steps forward for current and prospective Eagles families this season.

home_whats_new_items.title: Youth Strength & Conditioning
home_whats_new_items.description: Age-appropriate strength programs for our youngest players, built on movement quality and injury prevention.

home_whats_new_items.title: Speed & Agility
home_whats_new_items.description: Dedicated speed and agility sessions to build first-step quickness, baserunning speed, and defensive range.

home_whats_new_items.title: New Eagles Baseball Facility — Coming Soon
home_whats_new_items.description: A new home for the Eagles with cages, mounds, and turf for year-round training.

home_whats_new_items.title: Dedicated Weight Room for 14U+
home_whats_new_items.description: A dedicated weight room and structured lifting program to prepare 14U and older players for high school baseball.

home_whats_new_items.title: High School Eagles Program
home_whats_new_items.description: Eagles baseball now continues past 14U with a program built for high school players.

home_offerings.title: Competitive Teams
home_offerings.description: Age-group teams from 9U to 17U competing in top regional tournaments.

home_offerings.title: Professional Coaching
home_offerings.description: Experienced coaches focused on player development on and off the field.

home_offerings.title: Camps & Clinics
home_offerings.description: Seasonal skills camps for hitting, pitching, fielding, and catching.

home_offerings.title: Training Facility
home_offerings.description: Indoor cages, mounds, and turf for year-round development.
